verdict.rationale: The evidence lists Colorado SOS filing types (LLCs, corporations, name reservations, foreign entities, periodic reports, apostilles), but no item publishes a fee amount or a fee schedule for any transaction. Fee publication is a fair question for a state business registry, so the absence of evidence makes this "none", not "na".

support.subject: As a founder, the exact statutory fees for my transaction are published on the service's own pages — amounts, not a contact form
